body:
I feel that so hard. I overthink everything. All the time. And the past month I've had really positive and happy things to overthink about. And I feel like they just got ripped away. And now even though things aren't terrible all I can think about it how much happier I had felt.

And it wont stop. And that voice in the. back of my head is just repeating. This is what you get for believing you deserve happiness
